project.name: [SANDBOX] Dogfood Expanded - Agent Workflow Redesign
project.brief: Create an expanded-mode project to redesign an agent-heavy workflow with deep research, project principles, companion docs, dependency map, QA plan, handoff docs, and multiple issue types.
principles: Expanded mode is opt-in and must not contaminate baseline mode.
Research and provenance are planned work, not chat-only notes.
Coordinator owns Linear state, dependency map, QA plan, and final integration.

issues.title: Guide: Agent Operating Guide
issues.description:
## Objective
Define expanded-mode operating rules, source of truth, baseline protection, and first safe issue.

## Background Context
This project deliberately exercises expanded mode.

## Owned Scope
- Operating guide and coordinator responsibilities.

## Non-Owned Scope
- Runtime implementation and release metadata.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Original prompt is preserved.
- Local docs root and ledger path are named.
- Baseline contamination rules are explicit.

## Verification Requirements
Read back project graph, ledger, and local docs plan.

## Handoff / Context Recovery Notes
Future agents start from this guide, the ledger, and DOG-E-003 dependency map.

issues.title: Research current agent workflow and OpenAI/Codex patterns
issues.description:
## Objective
Create a research dossier grounding the workflow redesign in local evidence and official OpenAI/Codex docs.

## Background Context
Expanded mode requires source-backed planning before implementation.

## Inputs / Required Reading
- Original brief
- SKILL.md
- references/expanded-mode.md
- Official OpenAI Codex docs for skills, AGENTS.md, subagents, and compaction

## Owned Scope
- Research dossier only.

## Non-Owned Scope
- Dependency map and implementation edits.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Source-backed facts and project inferences are separated.
- OpenAI/Codex URLs or Context7 library IDs are recorded.
- Refresh triggers are documented.

## Verification Requirements
Review the dossier for source scope, source links, and implications.

## Required Updates
Update the ledger research row and link the dossier.

issues.title: Build dependency map and parallel allocation plan
issues.description:
## Objective
Create the dependency map, edge rationale, parallel batches, and serial gates.

## Background Context
Parallel implementation must wait for explicit ownership and verification gates.

## Inputs / Required Reading
- Research dossier
- Expanded-mode dependency map template
- Current issue graph

## Owned Scope
- Dependency map and allocation table.

## Non-Owned Scope
- Implementation edits.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Parent workstreams and child issues are mapped.
- Edges identify blocker, dependency, human-gate, and integration-zone relationships.
- Parallel-safe batches name non-overlap rationale.

## Verification Requirements
Run `linear-agent allocate` and compare output with dependency map.

## Required Updates
Update ledger Safe Parallelism Decisions and dependency-map doc.

issues.title: Create project principles and QA plan
issues.description:
## Objective
Create the project principles document and QA plan.

## Background Context
This expanded project needs durable decision rules and verification gates.

## Inputs / Required Reading
- Research dossier
- templates/project-principles.md
- templates/expanded-mode/qa-plan.md

## Owned Scope
- Principles document and QA plan.

## Non-Owned Scope
- Dependency map edge table and implementation work.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Non-negotiables, quality bar, anti-goals, and amendment rules are present.
- QA plan includes baseline checks, issue checks, final read-back, and handoff gate.

## Verification Requirements
Review for required sections and link both artifacts from the ledger.

## Required Updates
Update the ledger principles surface and verification matrix references.

issues.title: Implement workflow reference updates
issues.description:
## Objective
Update references that describe the redesigned agent workflow.

## Background Context
This lane owns reference docs only and can run beside template updates.

## Owned Scope
- references/workflow-related docs.

## Non-Owned Scope
- Templates, release metadata, installed runtime copy.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Checkpoint model is represented in the reference.
- Source material rereading is phase-specific.
- Baseline mode remains concise.

## Verification Requirements
Run front-door and dogfood evaluators.

## Handoff / Context Recovery Notes
Coordinator integrates after DOG-E-006.

issues.title: Implement template and fixture updates
issues.description:
## Objective
Update templates and fixtures so future projects preserve checkpoint and handoff evidence.

## Background Context
This lane owns templates and dogfood fixtures only.

## Owned Scope
- templates/** and tests/fixtures/**.

## Non-Owned Scope
- Runtime CLI and release metadata.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Companion ledger template includes source-material checkpoint log.
- Dogfood fixtures cover normal, expanded, and continuous-discovery modes.

## Verification Requirements
Run dogfood evaluator and shell regression tests.

## Required Updates
Update ledger and dependency map with any shape changes.

issues.title: Dogfood, final QA, and handoff
issues.description:
## Objective
Run live dogfood, final QA, and create handoff evidence.

## Background Context
Expanded-mode changes require proof that baseline behavior stayed intact.

## Inputs / Required Reading
- QA plan
- Dependency map
- Full evaluator output

## Owned Scope
- Dogfood evidence and handoff document.

## Non-Owned Scope
- New implementation changes after QA starts unless a blocker is discovered.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Baseline tests pass.
- Dogfood evaluator passes.
- Remaining risks and next iteration are documented.

## Verification Requirements
Run all repo tests/evaluators and read back fake Linear graph.

## Required Updates
Update handoff doc, ledger, and final completion comment.
